Harrowgate Lighting moves its head office to Leeds

LEEDS, 12 May 2026 – Harrowgate Lighting today moved its head office from Sheffield to Leeds, bringing 40 staff under one roof.

"We are delighted to announce the move, because it puts our designers and engineers in the same building," said Priya Lennox, Managing Director of Harrowgate Lighting.

The company is headquartered in Leeds. The plan was approved last week. The firm's first product from the new office, the Lumen 2 desk lamp, goes on sale on 1 June 2026 at £35. The device is designed to cut energy use.
